text:
Nina Brooks: Need help coordinating in-person final for Emiliano Rossi (arriving from Rome). Candidate requested accessible room (low lighting, quiet space) and a travel stipend instead of company-booked flight. Interview day: Tue next week, window 10:00-15:00 EDT.
Julian Park: I can do system design 10:00-11:00 EDT. OK with low-light room.
Lina Gomez: Coding interviewer  I can do 11:30-12:30 or 12:45-13:45. Prefer 11:30 start.
Marcus Hale: HM wrap 14:00-14:30. Also: candidate asked for neurodiversity accommodations (extra breaks and written prompts). We should confirm and note in interview guide.
Nina Brooks: Good point re accommodations. Emiliano said: "I use noise-cancelling headphones, prefer written instructions for tasks, and one 15-min quiet break during the loop." We need room, break scheduling, and add written task prompts in invite.
Facilities-bot: Accessible room options: Quiet Room A (4th floor) and Quiet Room B (11th floor, lower lighting). Quiet Room A has adjustable desk and is near elevator (no stairs). Which floor preferred?
Nina Brooks: Quiet Room A please (closer to elevator). Also we need a sensory-friendly lunch (no strong odors) and low-scent table.
TravelOps: Stipend flow: candidate-paid travel with stipend works. We issue a guaranteed stipend code (USD 350) via Travel Portal. Candidate submits receipts for anything > stipend to be reimbursed. Guidance link: https://travel.redwood.ai/stipend-policy. Need Emiliano's preferred airport arrival time to suggest stipend vs booking.
Nina Brooks: Emiliano prefers stipend. Arrival: JFK Tue 07:40 EDT. He has a carry-on only. He requested ground pickup if possible due to limited mobility after long flights.
TravelOps: We can schedule a designated driver pickup (car service) from JFK. Estimated cost USD 80 round trip. TravelOps will mark as company expense if candidate accepts pickup. Please confirm.
Marcus Hale: Pickup ok from me. If candidate prefers a stipend and to arrange their own transport, still offer company pickup as fallback.
Lina Gomez: For the coding session, can we provide a printed problem statement and allow Emiliano to type answers in CoderPad? Also we should plan for a 15-min break after coding.
Nina Brooks: Yes. Plan: 10:00-11:00 design, 11:00-11:20 break (quiet area), 11:20-12:20 coding (printed prompt + CoderPad), 12:20-13:00 lunch break, 13:00-14:00 pair design/deep dive (optional), 14:00-14:30 HM wrap. Can panelers confirm?
Julian Park: Confirmed. 13:00-14:00 I can do follow-up deep dive if needed.
Lina Gomez: Confirmed for 11:20-12:20 coding and 15-min buffer after.
Facilities-bot: Reserved Quiet Room A, access ramp confirmed, adjustable desk set, low-scent lunch ordered (vendor note: no strong spices). Parking: Visitor bay VP-778 reserved. AV: projector off by default for low-light preference; laptop HDMI available if needed.
TravelOps: Pickup booked (CarService ID CS-7789) for Tue 07:40 arrival. Driver will wait at Terminal 4 arrivals, contact number will be sent to candidate. If candidate declines pickup, stipend code USD350 will be issued instantly.
Nina Brooks: I'll send candidate message now (excerpt): "Thanks Emiliano  we've reserved an accessible quiet room and can provide company pickup from JFK or a USD350 stipend. We'll provide printed prompts and a quiet lunch. Please confirm which you prefer and share phone number for pickup if accepted"
recruiter-bot: Draft calendar event created: https://calendar.redwood.ai/events/1872501111  invites pending until candidate confirms pickup vs stipend. Event includes: Quiet Room A, printed prompts, 20-min break after design, sensory-friendly lunch note, and accessibility contact.
Marcus Hale: One more ask: please add a checkbox in the interview guide: "Written prompts provided?" and "Break scheduled?" so interviewers remember accommodations.
Nina Brooks: Will add to the guide and attach to the calendar event. Also uploading a 1-paragraph LOA template in case candidate borrows any equipment (unlikely).
TravelOps: Stipend code ready to issue. Candidate phone placeholder required to send car service contact: +39 345 678 9012? Is that Emiliano's?
Nina Brooks: Emiliano provided +39 345 678 9012 and passport name Emiliano Rossi. Pronouns he/him. He confirmed he wants the company pickup.
TravelOps: Confirmed pickup assigned. CarService driver contact +1-555-0100. TravelOps attached booking ID CS-7789 to calendar event.
Lina Gomez: Thanks everyone. I'll bring printed prompt and a spare keyboard in case candidate prefers that.
recruiter-bot: Reminder scheduled: send candidate pre-visit checklist 48h before arrival and a mobility/access contact 24h before.
